Hymn 231: Father, Cheer Our Souls Tonight
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Lillian Hansen Petersen

This is hymn number 231 titled "Father, Cheer Our Souls Tonight" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Lillian Hansen Petersen.
